Hi Elif,

Thanks for your message.

PO 1171 is currently in transit, with delivery scheduled for 2026-11-12.

Regarding the customer list: I'm afraid I can't share our full customer list or their contact details, as that information is confidential to each customer. If your ERP import needs delivery-point data, we're happy to provide the details specific to Saltmarsh Foods' own account and orders, or to work with your team on another way to pre-register delivery points as orders come in.

Best regards,
Elif Sato
Northwind Analytics
